dash_change: one U+2013 becomes U+002D; all else exact

rules.controls: Native unchanged and same-work human substitutions, plus native PDF, rotated scan, missing page, mixed extraction and weak recognition excluded controls; zero whole-document weight
rules.gate: >=2 known useful edits across distinct source groups and >=2 generator families, <=1 new ordinary false source group relative to equivalent native same-window baseline, all scored windows independently source-addressable
rules.scope: English, 68-420 words, 1 or 4 paragraphs (4 sentences if 1), 1-2 fully OCR upright pages, all OCR blocks, per-page mean >=95, no partial pages
rules.useful: >=0.30 non-space IoU and >=0.50 recall of exact known native edit mapped by matching codepoints; denominator retains unmapped truth
rules.window: Current fixed primary and secondary points, first six primary-positive complete current contexts each confined to one page and exact word-box coverage with every intersecting word >=80 recognition quality
